Selection barriers

Why AI confuses landscape and site-improvement services

Landscape design, planting, drainage construction and seasonal maintenance require different capabilities.

01

Renderings are mistaken for constructed gardens

A design visualisation does not show the company delivered planting or paving. Real roles, completion stages and photo permissions must be established.

02

Seasonal obligations are missing

Plant establishment depends on species, site conditions, irrigation and upkeep. Blanket survival promises need actual contractual support.

03

Local regulations are generalized

Municipal and private sites can face different rules; the scope of relevant standards and local requirements must be verified for the works.

Buyer intents

Questions that shape landscaping recommendations

Each buyer group needs its own evidence and prompt set.

Buyer questionFacts to verifyGEO work
Who designs and plants private gardens in our area?Real portfolio, design authorship, planted work and aftercareSeparate planning from delivered landscaping
Which contractor installs paths, drainage and lighting?Construction layers, drainage, electrical responsibility and quoteShow documented work packages
Who can improve commercial office grounds?Comparable sites, construction stages, access and maintenancePublish substantiated corporate projects
Who maintains public greenery year round?Seasonal crews, maintenance schedule, locality and contractsDifferentiate ongoing service from one-off works
Verifiable facts

Evidence supporting responsible recommendations

SP 82.13330.2016 addresses certain territory-improvement solutions, GOST R 71473-2024 defines landscape terms, and a September 2026 Ministry of Construction letter clarifies that work classification depends on the contract and site. None certifies an individual firm.

  • Real sites: type, date, design and construction roles and approved portfolio images
  • Technical scope: terrain, soil, drainage, planting material, paving specifications and limits
  • Contract scope: phases, seasonal timing, maintenance, handover, real warranty conditions and service regions

This methodology page does not claim measured GEO outcomes for a landscaping client.

FAQ

Questions about the service

Can a design-only studio use GEO?+

Yes, provided designs are clearly described and not shown as completed planting or installation.

Does SP 82.13330.2016 cover every home garden?+

No blanket conclusion applies; verify the site, actual works and applicable local rules.

Should planting and drainage share one service page?+

They can link to each other but need distinct technical scope and evidence where services differ.

Can an AI recommendation guarantee plant survival?+

No. Survival depends on site and maintenance; only case-specific contractual terms can define any warranty.

How much does landscape GEO cost?+

Published GAEO plans apply; scope depends on regions, actual services, portfolio and baseline prompts.
